svg.text: Local-first hybrid search (semantic + full-text) with RAG over your own files
Every chunk is written to both indexes
User query — “what did the budget say?”
Query is embedded with the same model as index time
top-K semantic hits + top-K keyword hits,
fetched in parallel from both indexes
Everything runs locally · no data leaves the machine unless a cloud LLM provider is configured.
Configured end-to-end by config.yaml · scheduled re-indexing via scheduler.py (APScheduler)
